name: song-video-render-host
purpose: One operator-supervised song-video render loop on the selected pinned-input FFmpeg host

image.runtime: bun 1.4 (the workspace scripts run directly from the checkout)

invocation.image: built from infra/cloudflare/song-video-render-host/Dockerfile with the pinned FFmpeg tarball URL and digest

policy.claim: the attempt row is claimed by compare-and-set before FFmpeg runs; one row per pass, and a lost or duplicate invocation cannot execute it again
policy.retry: never; an uncertain execution is left pending for reconciliation
policy.output: written once to the accepted master address; no address is reused
policy.measure: songs waiting for a canonical duration are measured before each claim pass

work.selection: without SONG_VIDEO_RENDER_PLAN_ID, the oldest waiting attempt; with it, one targeted pass on that plan and optional SONG_VIDEO_RENDER_ATTEMPT_ID
work.source_of_truth: media_song_video_render_attempts at started/submitting or started/submitted with no recorded execution evidence

outcomes.loop: runs until SIGINT or SIGTERM; each concluded attempt prints one JSON line
outcomes.accepted: master revision id printed; the output was sealed and accepted
outcomes.refused: refusal reason printed; the attempt is abandoned by the workflow
outcomes.not_claimed: no waiting attempt this pass; the loop waits and tries again
outcomes.pending: printed as pending; the attempt stays claimed and is never rendered again
outcomes.targeted_pass: with a plan id, the one pass exits 0, or 2 when the execution stayed pending

authorization.note: Host, cost ceiling, window and execution each still require separate approval. This file is configuration only.
